description: Find facilities in Japan near a latitude/longitude — convenience stores, stations, hospitals, pharmacies, restaurants, ATMs and other POIs. Use when you already have coordinates rather than a station name. Answers "what's within 300m of 35.6595,139.7005 in Tokyo" style questions. Returns each place's name, category, distance in metres and coordinates, sourced from OpenStreetMap.

category.description: What to find: "convenience_store", "station", "hospital", "pharmacy", "restaurant", "cafe", "supermarket", "bank", "atm", "hotel", "post_office", "toilet", "parking", "temple", "shrine", "park" — or an exact OSM tag like "shop=bakery".

name: places_near_point
